_rules.doubleCostNote: Skills flagged doubleCost cost 2 Skill Points per Level.
_rules.culturalOriginLanguage: Every Character gets 4 free points in a Language tied to their Cultural Origin (Lifepath p.45). Granted, not purchased — never deduct from the Skill Point budget.

skills.name: Concentration
skills.description: Skill of focus and mental control, encompassing feats of memory, recall, ignoring distractions, and physiological mastery.

skills.name: Conceal/Reveal Object
skills.description: Skill for hiding objects and finding objects that have been hidden. This is the Skill used for concealing weapons under clothing and detecting concealed weapons.

skills.name: Lip Reading
skills.description: Skill of reading someone's lips to tell what they are saying.

skills.name: Perception
skills.description: Skill of spotting hidden things like clues, traps, and people using the Stealth Skill, but not objects hidden with the Conceal/Reveal Object Skill.

skills.name: Tracking
skills.description: Skill of following a trail by observing tracks and other clues left behind.

skills.name: Athletics
skills.description: Skill of jumping, climbing, throwing, swimming, lifting weights, etc.

skills.name: Contortionist
skills.description: Skill of manipulating your body to get out of handcuffs or other bindings and to fit yourself into otherwise inaccessible places or spaces.

skills.name: Dance
skills.description: Skill of dancing at a professional level.

skills.name: Endurance
skills.description: Skill of withstanding harsh environmental conditions and hardship.

skills.name: Resist Torture/Drugs
skills.description: Skill of resisting painful effects including interrogation, torture, and drugs.

skills.name: Stealth
skills.description: Skill of moving quietly, hiding, doing an Action discreetly, or otherwise evading detection. Other Characters can try to find you with their Perception Skill.

skills.name: Drive Land Vehicle
skills.description: Skill of driving and maneuvering land vehicles.

skills.name: Pilot Air Vehicle
skills.description: Skill of piloting and maneuvering air vehicles.

skills.name: Pilot Sea Vehicle
skills.description: Skill of piloting and maneuvering sea vehicles.

skills.name: Riding
skills.description: Skill of riding a living creature trained for the purpose.

skills.name: Accounting
skills.description: Skill of balancing books, creating false books and identifying them, juggling numbers, creating budgets, and handling day to day business operations.

skills.name: Animal Handling
skills.description: Skill of handling, training, and caring for animals.

skills.name: Bureaucracy
skills.description: Skill for dealing with bureaucrats, knowing who to talk to in a bureaucracy, how to reach them, and how to extract information from bureaucracies.

skills.name: Business
skills.description: Skill regarding knowledge of basic business practices, laws of supply and demand, employee management, procurement, sales, marketing.

skills.name: Composition
skills.description: Skill of professionally writing songs, articles, or stories.

skills.name: Criminology
skills.description: Skill for looking for clues by dusting for fingerprints, doing ballistic tests, examining evidence, and searching through police records and files.

skills.name: Cryptography
skills.description: Skill of encrypting and decoding messages.

skills.name: Deduction
skills.description: Skill of taking several clues and leaping to a non-obvious conclusion or medical diagnosis.

skills.name: Education
skills.description: Skill of general knowledge, equivalent to a basic school education, allowing you to know how to read, write, use basic math, and know enough history to get by.

skills.name: Gamble
skills.description: Skill of knowing how to figure odds and play games of chance successfully.

skills.name: Language
skills.description: Skill of speaking a particular language. You must choose a specific language whenever you increase this Skill.

skills.name: Library Search
skills.description: Skill of using databases, Data Pools, libraries, and other compiled information sources to find facts.

skills.name: Local Expert
skills.description: Skill of knowing a specific area well and knowing the agendas of its various factions, both political and criminal. You must choose a specific location whenever you increase this Skill, which cannot be any larger than a single neighborhood or community.

skills.name: Science
skills.description: Skill for knowing how to design experiments, write scientific papers, test hypotheses, and discuss with other academics in a particular field of science. An area of study must be specified whenever this Skill is increased. Possible options include: Geology, Mathematics, Physics, Zoology, Anthropology, Biology, Chemistry, History, etc.

skills.name: Tactics
skills.description: Skill of managing a large-scale battle effectively and efficiently. A Character with this Skill usually knows what must be done to direct a battle, and how an enemy force may react.

skills.name: Wilderness Survival
skills.description: Skill for knowing how to survive comfortably in the wilderness.

skills.name: Brawling
skills.description: Skill at fighting and grappling with brute strength.

skills.name: Evasion
skills.description: Skill for getting out of the way of someone attacking you in melee. A Character with REF 8 or higher can also use this Skill to dodge Ranged Attacks.

skills.name: Martial Arts
skills.description: Skill for fighting with a Martial Arts Form. Each time you increase this Skill you must choose in which form you are training. You can learn multiple forms, but you must do so separately. Common forms include Karate, Taekwondo, Judo, and Aikido.

skills.name: Melee Weapon
skills.description: Skill for fighting with melee weapons.

skills.name: Acting
skills.description: Skill of assuming a role, disguising yourself as someone else, whether real or fictitious, and faking emotions and moods.

skills.name: Play Instrument
skills.description: Skill of professionally playing a musical instrument. You can choose which instrument when you increase this Skill. Possible options include: singing, guitar, drums, violin, piano, etc.

skills.name: Archery
skills.description: Skill for accurately firing bolt- or arrow-launching projectile weapons.

skills.name: Autofire
skills.description: Skill for keeping a weapon's Autofire firing mode on target through recoil.

skills.name: Handgun
skills.description: Skill for accurately firing handheld projectile weapons such as pistols.

skills.name: Heavy Weapons
skills.description: Skill for accurately firing extremely large projectile weapons, including grenade and rocket launchers.

skills.name: Shoulder Arms
skills.description: Skill for accurately firing shoulder-braced projectile weapons, including rifles and shotguns.

skills.name: Bribery
skills.description: Skill of knowing when to bribe someone, how to approach them, and how much to offer.

skills.name: Conversation
skills.description: Skill of extracting information from people without alerting them with careful conversation.

skills.name: Human Perception
skills.description: Skill of reading a person's facial expressions and body language to discern their emotional state and detect lies or deception.

skills.name: Interrogation
skills.description: Skill of forcibly extracting information from people.

skills.name: Persuasion
skills.description: Skill of convincing, persuading, or influencing individuals.

skills.name: Personal Grooming
skills.description: Skill of knowing proper grooming to maximize attractiveness.

skills.name: Streetwise
skills.description: Skill of making and using contacts to get illegal goods and contraband, talking to the criminal element, and avoiding bad situations in bad neighborhoods.

skills.name: Trading
skills.description: Skill of striking a good bargain with a merchant or customer.

skills.name: Wardrobe & Style
skills.description: Skill of knowing the clothes to wear and when to wear them.

skills.name: Air Vehicle Tech
skills.description: Skill of repairing and maintaining air vehicles.

skills.name: Basic Tech
skills.description: Skill of identifying, understanding, and repairing simple electronic and mechanical devices and all other items not covered by another Technique Skill.

skills.name: Cybertech
skills.description: Skill of identifying, understanding, and repairing cybernetics.

skills.name: Demolitions
skills.description: Skill of setting and defusing explosives, and knowing how much explosive will accomplish a desired result.

skills.name: Electronics/Security Tech
skills.description: Skill of identifying, understanding, repairing, countering, and installing complex electronic devices, including: computers, cyberdecks, personal electronics, electronic security systems, bugs and tracers, pressure plates, laser tripwires, etc.

skills.name: First Aid
skills.description: Skill of applying medical treatments to a wounded person to treat the most common Critical Injuries and keep them from dying.

skills.name: Forgery
skills.description: Skill of creating and detecting false documents and identification.

skills.name: Land Vehicle Tech
skills.description: Skill of repairing and maintaining land vehicles.

skills.name: Paint/Draw/Sculpt
skills.description: Skill of producing professional paintings, drawings, or sculpture.

skills.name: Paramedic
skills.description: Skill of applying medical treatments to a wounded person to treat all Critical Injuries not requiring Surgery and keep them from dying (Surgery is only available to Medtechs through their Role Ability, Medicine).

skills.name: Photography/Film
skills.description: Skill for producing photographs, videos, or braindances.

skills.name: Pick Lock
skills.description: Skill for bypassing non-electronic locks.

skills.name: Pick Pocket
skills.description: Skill for stealthily retrieving items secured on another person and shoplifting small items without being noticed.

skills.name: Sea Vehicle Tech
skills.description: Skill of repairing and maintaining sea vehicles.

skills.name: Weaponstech
skills.description: Skill for repairing and maintaining weapons of all types.
